newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Log-Tek rejigs shares, seeks black backers.
newsitem.headline: Log-Tek rejigs shares, seeks black backers.

text.p: South Africa's Log-Tek Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that it is rejigging its capital structure and may seek seek to get the support of a black empowerment group as a major shareholder.
The firm, which provides training and educational franchising, said it plans to create a new class of "N" ordinary shares and then launch a capitalisation issue of these shares.
Log-Tek added that it would also seek general permission from its shareholders for permission to issue new ordinary or "N" class shares to raise cash.

"(This) will enable the directors of Log-Tek to have further flexibility to take advantage of favourable opportunities which may arise, in particular, regarding the introduction of a black empowerment group as a major shareholder," the firm said in a statement.
